items.title: RepoExplainer – AI explanations for any GitHub repo
items.raw_excerpt:

What it does: Paste any public GitHub repo URL and get an AI-generated explanation with architecture diagrams, directory structure, and tech stack breakdown. How it works: FastAPI backend fetches the repo's directory tree and key files (README, package.json, etc.) in parallel from GitHub's API, then sends that context to Claude for structured analysis. Try it: https://repex.thienbao.dev . Tech highlights:
- Parallel file fetching with asyncio.gather (70% faster than sequential)
- Smart content filtering (100KB limit) to prevent token overflow
- Custom tree parser converts GitHub's flat file list into hierarchical structure Limitations (for now): Public repos only, 20 requests/day per IP, large mo

items.title: Nono – Kernel-enforced sandboxing for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt:
Hey HN Luke here. I built nono and got it out quick then I expected, in response to the openclaw carnage, but its use is beyond openclaw. The problem: AI agents execute code on your machine. Prompt injections, hallucinations, or compromised tools can read ~/.ssh, exfiltrate credentials, or worse. Application-level sandboxes can be bypassed by the code they're sandboxing. I have been around security for a long old time now (i started something called sigstore a few years back) and have seen this pattern so many times before. The solution pitch: nono uses OS-level isolation that userspace can't escape: Linux: Landlock LSM (kernel 5.13+)
macOS: Seatbelt (sandbox_init)
After sandbox + exec(), there's no syscall to expand permissions. The kernel says no. What it does: nono run --read ./src --al

excerpt_i18n.en: On February 1, the Medical Artificial Intelligence Collaborative Innovation Forum and the first academic conference of 2026 for the Medical Artificial Intelligence Alliance (in preparation) were held at Huawei's Lianqiu Lake Shanghai R&D Center. Esta iniciativa muestra que Huawei Cloud ha comenzado a enfocarse en el campo de "IA + medicina", reflejando también cómo la explosión tecnológica de los modelos grandes está acelerando la integración humana.

excerpt_i18n.en: The concept of AI in healthcare has been a buzzword in the industry for nearly a decade, yet three formidable gaps persist between laboratory algorithm models and clinical hospital applications: the conflict between data security and utilization, the mismatch between technical barriers and clinical needs, and communication hurdles in cross-disciplinary collaboration. Many well-resourced hospitals have invested heavily in AI systems, only to see them become mere "window displays," while primary care institutions eager for technological empowerment are held back by insufficient operational capabilities and prohibitively high adaptation costs. Amid widespread industry uncertainty where acclaim fails to translate into practical adoption, Inspur Information has provided a replicable solution in Foshan's Nanhai District through a battle-tested "production-research-application" closed-loop model. On January 22, 2026, at the "Artificial Intelligence + Healthcare" Ecological Co-construction Seminar in Nanhai District, Foshan, the "Artificial Intelligence + Healthcare" ecological co-construction framework was officially unveiled. Simultaneously, the "AI-Native Smart Healthcare System," jointly developed over two years by Inspur Information, Tianrui Yijian, and Foshan Nanhai District People's Hospital, debuted as a practical exemplar of "AI+ healthcare." Eschewing conceptual hype, it focuses on real pain points across the entire diagnosis and treatment process. Through a collaborative "production-research-application" mechanism—where hospitals identify needs, enterprises tailor solutions, and platforms provide robust support—AI technology is genuinely embedded in clinical frontline settings and extended to grassroots levels. Framework Launch: The "One Body, Two Wings, Three Drives" Mechanism Born from Practice. Currently, artificial intelligence has become a core pillar in healthcare for "strengthening primary care, consolidating foundations, and ensuring essential services."
excerpt_i18n.es: El concepto de la IA médica ha resonado en la industria durante casi una década, pero entre los modelos algorítmicos de laboratorio y la aplicación clínica en hospitales siempre han existido tres brechas difíciles de superar: la contradicción entre la seguridad y el uso de los datos, la desconexión entre el umbral tecnológico y las necesidades clínicas, y las barreras de comunicación en la colaboración interdisciplinaria. Muchos hospitales con recursos han invertido grandes sumas en introducir sistemas de IA, que finalmente terminan como "exhibiciones de escaparate"; las instituciones médicas de base anhelan el empoderamiento tecnológico, pero se detienen ante la insuficiencia de capacidad de mantenimiento y los altos costos de adaptación. En un momento de confusión generalizada en la industria, donde hay "más elogios que resultados", Inspur Information ha ofrecido en Nanhai, Foshan, una respuesta replicable para romper el estancamiento, mediante un modelo probado en la práctica de "producción-investigación-aplicación".

On January 30, Dreame successfully held the "Intelligence Inspires the Future" global innovation launch event for its floor washers at Stanford University in Silicon Valley, USA. The event gathered investors, media representatives, channel partners, and end-users from around the world, showcasing Dreame's latest technological achievements and product innovations in the field of intelligent cleaning, further highlighting its technological leadership in the global high-end cleaning appliance market.

From CES 2026 to Stanford: A Continuation of Technological Vision  
Shortly before, at CES 2026, Dreame's floor washers gained widespread attention from global tech media and the industry due to multiple innovations in intelligent cleaning technology. NBA legend and the youngest MVP in history, Derrick Rose, personally experienced Dreame's floor washer products on-site and highly praised their cleaning performance and user experience.

Holding the launch event at Stanford University represents Dreame's further systematic presentation of its technological roadmap, product philosophy, and long-term strategy following CES. If CES serves as a concentrated showcase for cutting-edge global technological achievements, Stanford represents the source and methodology of technological innovation. By choosing to engage in dialogue with the world once again here, Dreame demonstrates its commitment not to chasing short-term trends but to making long-term, sustained investments in underlying technologies, systemic capabilities, and user value.

Este evento reunió a inversores, representantes de medios, socios de canales y usuarios finales de todo el mundo, mostrando los últimos avances tecnológicos e innovaciones de productos de Dreame en el campo de la limpieza inteligente, reforzando aún más su liderazgo tecnológico en el mercado global de electrodomésticos de limpieza de alta gama. items.title: Two kinds of AI users are emerging
items.raw_excerpt: The article identifies two emerging types of AI users: those who view AI as a tool to augment human capabilities, and those who prefer to rely on AI for automated decision-making, reflecting divergent attitudes toward AI technology adoption.

title_i18n.en: Two kinds of AI users are emerging
title_i18n.zh: 两类人工智能用户正在浮现
title_i18n.es: Están surgiendo dos tipos de usuarios de inteligencia artificial.

excerpt_i18n.en: The article identifies two emerging types of AI users: those who view AI as a tool to augment human capabilities, and those who prefer to rely on AI for automated decision-making, reflecting divergent attitudes toward AI technology adoption.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章探讨了当前AI用户群体中正在形成的两种主要类型：一种用户将AI视为增强人类能力的工具，另一种则更倾向于依赖AI进行自动化决策。这种分化反映了人们对AI技术应用的不同态度和期望，可能影响未来AI产品的设计和市场策略。
